# WeThinkDigital

> WeThinkDigital is an AI and software engineering company. We build AI automation,
> autonomous agent systems, custom software and modern web applications. Headquarters:
> Dubai, United Arab Emirates; we work with teams worldwide. Contact:
> hello@wethinkdigital.solutions, +971 58 929 3060. Languages: English and Arabic.

## Services

- [AI automation](https://www.wethinkdigital.solutions/services/ai-automation): agentic workflows that take repetitive operational work off human hands — data pipelines, internal copilots, process automation wired into existing tools.
- [AI engineering](https://www.wethinkdigital.solutions/services/ai-engineering): LLM and agent systems built into a product — retrieval-augmented generation, evaluation harnesses, multi-agent orchestration, tool calling, guardrails, cost control.
- [Custom software development](https://www.wethinkdigital.solutions/services/software-development): product engineering end to end — APIs, data models, platform services, cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, test automation.
- [Web development](https://www.wethinkdigital.solutions/services/web-development): fast, accessible web applications and sites on modern React and TypeScript, measured against Core Web Vitals.

## Products

- [Agents](https://www.wethinkdigital.solutions/products/agents) — app at [agents.wethinkdigital.solutions](https://agents.wethinkdigital.solutions): a multi-agent platform that works a shared backlog. An SDE agent implements work items, a QA agent generates and runs tests, and a PR review agent comments on pull requests.
- [Resume](https://www.wethinkdigital.solutions/products/resume-ai) — app at [resume.wethinkdigital.solutions](https://resume.wethinkdigital.solutions): upload an existing resume and get back a clean, structured, recruiter-ready document, rewritten for clarity and tailored to a target role.

## More

- [Blog](https://www.wethinkdigital.solutions/blog): engineering notes on AI agents in the software lifecycle, production RAG, multi-agent orchestration, LLM cost control, automated code review and QA, performance work.
- [Contact](https://www.wethinkdigital.solutions/contact): scope a project or ask a technical question.
